A Critical Period for Rockstar Games

As anticipation builds for the November 19 launch of Grand Theft Auto 6, employees at Rockstar’s UK offices are set to hold a formal vote on union recognition. Running from November 12 to November 26, the ballot seeks to officially establish the Rockstar Game Workers Union as the UK gaming industry's largest recognized labor group.

Legal Challenges Continue

Simultaneously, a high-stakes employment tribunal is concluding. The IWUGB filed a complaint alleging union-busting following the October 2025 termination of over 30 employees, many of whom were union organizers. Rockstar maintains these layoffs were related to the unauthorized sharing of confidential information. Closing arguments are expected by November 18.

While management has stated they will respect the staff's choice regarding unionization, the outcome remains a focal point for labor relations in the sector. Further details are available at: https://www.engadget.com/2298907/rockstar-workers-in-uk-hold-union-vote-as-gta-6-release/
